{"data":{"id":"475391033346","type":"page","title":"System Search - How to check editing permissions for users","status":"current","spaceId":"4708335613","snapshotToken":"v:1","detail":"full","body":{"format":"markdown","value":"*Related Issues:*

<https://trebuco.atlassian.net/jira/servicedesk/projects/RCS/queues/custom/67/RCS-12040> 

*Investigation Steps:*

- Review the “Edit System Search Permission” in *system → ebr → ardm → store → builder → “Secure Store”* - example in the screenshot below:

- Users who are not part of any of the listed permission groups above, will not be able to edit the CardLink search (*system → ebr → smarttracksearches → “SameTenderCard Transactions”*); whereas users with any of the above permissions are able to “Save” over a CardLink search.
- To verify the Edit permission for users, within the transaction receipt (transaction viewer), click on the card number (hyperlink) 
- Once the card number (hyperlink) is clicked, the page is redirected to a “SameTenderCardTransactions” page (system search) - example below:

- Users with Edit permission can see “Composer” and “Save” options (as seen in the screenshot above).
- Note: Only Support has the “Edit” permission to directly edit the “SameTenderCardTransactions” system search (in *system → ebr → smarttracksearches → “SameTenderCard Transactions”*).
